description: Metadata for public research, publication, and news pages of the Oxford Institute for Ethics in AI. Each stored URL was confirmed with one bounded GET of HTML that stayed on www.oxford-aiethics.ox.ac.uk. The apex host redirects to www and is omitted, with other ox.ac.uk hosts, PDFs, and downloads. A challenge, HTTP error, non-HTML body, robots disallow, or off-host redirect is omitted. Rows keep title, publisher, canonical URL, date, and rights. Page text is not stored. creative_commons_attribution is CC BY alone. creative_commons is CC0, CC BY-SA, or a permissive mix. Sole restricted deeds keep their own tokens. A missing date is unknown. Updated, modified, and copyright years are not publication dates. uk_ogl requires Open Government Licence. runner_wired stays false.
